decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive spirits and tempo control cards. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Spectral Sailor and Mausoleum Wanderer, along with disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, the deck aims to establish an early board presence and maintain control of the game. Cards like Curious Obsession provide card advantage, while Slip Out the Back can help protect key creatures. With a focus on spirits and tempo play, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent for a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with powerful green creatures and planeswalkers, while ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck focuses on generating green devotion to fuel cards like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, and can use Storm the Festival to find more threats. Karn, the Great Creator can help search for important artifacts, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional acceleration and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to opponents.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar to generate powerful synergies. By sacrificing creatures and generating tokens, the deck aims to control the board while also dealing consistent damage to the opponent. Cards like Mayhem Devil and Fatal Push provide additional removal options, while Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn disrupt the opponent's strategy. With Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains access to a powerful mana source, allowing for more aggressive plays and greater flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing evasive Spirit creatures to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counter spells and removal. The goal is to establish a board presence quickly and maintain tempo by protecting your threats with cards like Spell Queller and Mausoleum Wanderer. Curious Obsession can help you draw cards and stay ahead while cards like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare provide additional control elements. With a mix of aggro and tempo strategies, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent while controlling the game.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, then flood the board with green devotion creatures such as Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and utilize the abundance of mana from Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to maintain pressure and secure victories.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to further strengthen its board presence and overwhelm opponents with high devotion to green. By focusing on aggressive gameplay and devotion to green, this deck aims to quickly outpace and overpower opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana-producing creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, then play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Using Storm the Festival, the player can search for more creatures and further build their board presence. The deck also utilizes devotion to green with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate even more mana and power up cards like Polukranos Reborn. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional utility and support for the aggressive strategy.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful spells to apply pressure on the opponent and quickly close out the game. With a mix of high-powered creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Werewolf Pack Leader, along with disruptive spells like The Akroan War, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can establish a strong defense. By utilizing a combination of mana acceleration and versatile creature cards, this deck seeks to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield and secure victory through fast and aggressive gameplay.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures and a fast-paced playstyle. The key strategy is to play multiple creatures quickly to build a strong board presence, while also utilizing cards like Resolute Reinforcements and Venerated Loxodon to buff your creatures and push for damage. With a mix of flying creatures, removal spells, and mana-fixing lands, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and close out games swiftly before giving the opponent a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, while controlling the game with Fires of Invention and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes a variety of powerful legendary creatures like Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The inclusion of the companion Keruga, the Macrosage allows for a higher curve and more powerful cards in the deck. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and enchantments.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells in the Rakdos color combination. It aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Key cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide ways to control the board and threaten the opponent's life total. The deck also includes some disruptive planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to give it versatility in different matchups. Overall, it aims to win through efficient aggression and disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The key concept is to efficiently use removal spells like Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant to clear the way for powerful creatures like Kroxa and Sheoldred. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional aggression. Liliana of the Veil can help control the battlefield while also providing discard options. The deck's mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By playing efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional power and resilience to the deck, allowing it to close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support a fast, consistent game plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of small, aggressive creatures. It includes cards that pump up the creatures' stats, protect them from removal, and enable them to quickly rebuild if the board is wiped. The deck aims to be fast and efficient, making the most out of its low-cost creatures and synergistic abilities to put pressure on the opponent and win the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures and use anthem effects to pump them up, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on synergy between creatures like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, while also providing protection with cards like Brave the Elements. Mutavault and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire provide additional creature support and Castle Ardenvale can create additional threats. This deck aims to quickly build a wide board presence and apply constant pressure to the opponent.
